strings.frmMain.lblDashboardNextBody.Text:
Use Project Scan to confirm the VCL source folder and the FMX output location before each run.
Review the Rules page when you need to control Critical Areas, Data Aware, 3rd Party, or WinAPI processing.
Use Conversion Output to monitor execution and to open or print the generated conversion report.
Use the mapping tabs as the operator reference for component, property, and event coverage.

strings.frmMain.lblProjectActionBody.Text:
Use the hero button at the top of the form to start a conversion from any screen.

Use Rules before you run if you want to turn individual converter families on or off for this pass.

Use Conversion Output during the run to watch the live log.
strings.frmMain.lblComponentHint.Text: Generated from the built-in mapping database so operators can inspect real conversion coverage.

strings.frmMain.lblRulesHint.Text: Choose which rule families to use for this conversion. Turn an option off to exclude that family.
strings.frmMain.lblCriticalHint.Text: Handles high-risk areas such as custom drawing, message patterns, owner-draw controls, action lists, thread sync, DPI assumptions, and related critical rewrites.
strings.frmMain.lblDataAwareHint.Text: Controls whether data-aware form analysis, binding preparation, and LiveBindings-oriented rewriting are enabled for this conversion run.
strings.frmMain.lblThirdPartyHint.Text: Controls whether third-party and catalog-based component analysis runs while the converter inspects DFM component trees.
strings.frmMain.lblWinAPIHint.Text: Controls whether Windows-message and WinAPI conversion patterns run before platform conditionals are injected into the Pascal output.
strings.frmMain.lblRulesSummaryNote.Text: The selected rule families apply to the next conversion. Review the conversion report, then compile and test the generated project.
